name: io.github.sepehr071/payping-mcp
title: PayPing
description: PayPing merchant account for agents: balance, sales, invoices; create invoices and payment links.

environmentVariables.name: PAYPING_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token from the PayPing panel (app.payping.ir, Connections > Developers > Tokens).

environmentVariables.name: PAYPING_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for requests to PayPing; system proxy settings are ignored.
